design_notes: Use hairline rules and two rule weights; serif throughout; single accent colour (e.g., deep blue).
Tables should be set with minimal borders, clear column headers, and right-aligned numbers.
Pull quote should be set in larger serif italic, with a hairline rule above and below.
Industry snapshot as a stat strip with three numbers, followed by a two-bar growth chart; no icons.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: The filing's industry section is the context the company wants investors to see.
industry_snapshot.rationale: Provides the three headline industry figures and a growth bar for the logistics projection, all traceable to the draft.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: The largest customer is Western Railway, a client since 2006
pull_quotes.quote: Western Railway alone contributes 52% of orders on hand
pull_quotes.rationale: A single, sharp number that captures the extreme customer concentration risk.

sidebars.body_markdown: The offer comprises 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 each, at an issue price to be determined. [^drhp-p29] The lead manager is Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited and the registrar is Bigshare Services Private Limited. [^drhp-p31] Proceeds are earmarked for working capital (₹1,130 lakhs) and general corporate purposes (amount not disclosed). [^drhp-p48] No independent appraisal or monitoring agency has been appointed. [^drhp-p18]
sidebars.rationale: Condenses the key offer terms into a scannable sidebar for quick reference.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance
